hypothesis_additions.claim: XRPL has broad observable on-ledger institutional adoption across payment channels, permissioned domains and tokenized assets.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Bitquery reports 58 payment-channel accounts, 15 permissioned-domain accounts, 76 MPT/tokenized-asset accounts and no bank/payment-company names in declared domains. Private rails, CEX activity and off-ledger integrations are outside this audit.

hypothesis_additions.claim: High XRPL transaction counts imply broad organic economic adoption.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Bitquery attributes 92% of August 2026 traffic to 767 machine-classified accounts; its human-scale heuristic leaves 0.80% of traffic. x402 is a counterexample of potentially useful machine activity but value/counterparty amounts are unknown.

hypothesis_additions.claim: x402 activity on XRPL represents a growing economically material AI-agent payment rail.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: 2.645M memo-tagged payments from 142 accounts are reported, but delivered value, net economic settlement, unique counterparties, repeat usage and fiat/asset conversion are not established.

hypothesis_additions.claim: RLUSD supply and transfer activity imply broad holder distribution and diversified economic usage on XRPL.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Bitquery reports top 10 addresses hold 81.6%, top 100 hold 99%, and typical monthly wallets receiving normal transfers around 1,000–2,500. Institutional/custodian concentration could explain some of this.

hypothesis_additions.claim: A 986x market-cap/net-exchange-flow ratio measures how much price appreciation each dollar of actual capital creates.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Market capitalization is price times supply; exchange netflows are token transfers, not fiat inflows or executed buys. The numerator and denominator are not comparable cash-flow quantities; CEX internal transfers, OTC, derivatives and order-book depth are not captured.
